title: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe and the five men arrested
description: Five men have been arrested as counter-terror police lead an investigation into a major incident near the airbase.

title: UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says
description: The US-Israel war with Iran has caused fuel prices to soar.

title: Thousands of illegal ghost plates on cars revealed by new cameras
description: Illegal registration plates are far too easy to get hold of and are putting the public at risk, BBC is told.

title: Police block Protestant Orange Order from controversial parade route
description: They had been unable to make the permitted parade on Sunday morning because protesters had gathered on the mainly-nationalist Garvaghy Road.

title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

title: Three dead, including child, in Channel crossing attempt
description: A 10-year-old child and two 30-year-old women were on board the boat - which was carrying 105 people.

title: Worker at care home investigated by BBC struck off for threatening elderly man
description: Amina Sani, who is Nigerian, was found to have threatened the 81-year-old with police and threatened to hit him.

title: Felled Sycamore Gap stump has 'encouraging' growth
description: A thick layer of growth surrounds the stump three years after the landmark was illegally felled.

title: British chess prodigy, 11, becomes youngest woman grandmaster
description: The 11-year-old has broken another chess record after a remarkable performance representing England.
